Its docstring records the detection it exists for (the 2026-09-10 -> 09-17 outage), so past dry_out this state is LOUD, not a silent death. (2) DECIDED: cadence stays 3/day and this loop will NOT stretch the runway to hide the drain. Measured basis: publishing is healthy (3-5 posts/day published 09-18..09-23, newest 2026-09-23T18:00:42Z, future queue 09-24..09-29 at 3/day), reach sits at ~3.1 impressions/post with 0 like/0 comment/0 save across 20 measured posts, so a 2/day trickle buys ~2 extra days of ~3-impression posts while contaminating the cadence config the pre-registered 09-28 and 10-05 gate reads reference.
